_comment: EN translation of tracks/chat/products/reka-chat.md — keys aligned by index with the Chinese source; facts unchanged.

axes.model_access: Dual pool of in-house models + curated open models: the Reka API model table verified same day lists reka-edge-2603 (16k context, text/image/video input) and reka-flash-3 (64k) alongside open tiers such as deepseek4-flash/glm5.3/qwen3.8-27b/gemma4-26b, all called through the api.reka.ai/v1 OpenAI-compatible endpoint; how the chat entry (app.reka.ai "Edge Chat") relates to the API pool was not verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Web entry at app.reka.ai (chat.reka.ai 307→app.reka.ai/chat, verified same day; page title "Reka Playground / Edge Chat"); plus an API (api.reka.ai/v1) and an open-weights local route (docs "Run locally": macOS Apple Silicon 32 GB+ / Linux serving).
axes.local_files: Hosted chat data is governed by the official privacy policy (June 2026 version verified same day), not verified item by item; the open Reka Edge weights run entirely on your own machine once downloaded (docs run-locally page on record) — hosted entry and local weights are two data boundaries.
axes.background: Chat returns immediately; no official statement verified for async/agentic task forms. The company's current mainline is research/Reka Cloud/video infrastructure/data infrastructure (four self-described sections on the homepage verified same day); the chat entry is not in the homepage's marquee area.
axes.tools: API-side tooling surface on record: the model table carries Tools/Structured outputs/Reasoning columns (reka-edge-2603 Yes on all three; reka-flash-3 Tools=No); the docs site ships its own MCP server (docs.reka.ai/_mcp/server, on record in llms.txt) for agents to read the docs.
axes.context: Conversations are organized per chat; no cross-session memory mechanism verified in official statements. On the API side context length varies by model (table same day: reka-edge-2603 16k, reka-flash-3 64k, open tiers 262k); the effective value in the chat entry was not verified.
axes.permissions: Account-gated (app.reka.ai requires login); contracting party Reka AI, Inc. (Terms of Use 2026-09: the contract covers reka.ai and its vision/creator/developer subdomains plus Reka Labs/Cloud/Vision services); the privacy page (June 2026) carries an EEA/UK section.
axes.fit: Fits: following the Reka in-house model line (Edge/Flash) + lining up curated open tiers (DeepSeek/GLM/Qwen/Gemma) through one API; wanting the Reka Edge open-weights local route. Not a fit: wanting a mature consumer chat product (thin entry surface, company focus has shifted to physical AI); wanting mainland-direct chat service (not filed).

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task set does not apply to chat products).

**Suggested runs** (three, each pointing at what the official pages do not give):

- **Which model the Edge Chat entry actually serves, and whether it matches the API model table** (the entry is a JS app, unverified)
- **Retention and training-use terms for hosted chat data** (read the June 2026 privacy policy item by item)
- **Hands-on feel of the Reka Edge weights local hardware bar** (docs say Apple Silicon 32 GB+, not actually tested)
unknowns:
- Model selection, memory, and file-upload features of the Edge Chat entry (no official statement verified)
- Retention and training-use terms for hosted chat data (not verified item by item)
- The exact license terms of the Reka Edge weights page (HF page not verified verbatim)
- How the chat entry relates to API quota/billing (pricing page on record in docs; entry side not verified)
related: Also multi-model aggregation chat: Poe headlines a closed-source API pool, while Reka's entry is thin and its aggregation surface sits mainly on the API side.
Open-weights local route contrast: Reka Edge weights, once downloaded, are carried by a local runner stack — data never leaves the machine.
OpenAI-compatible endpoint consumer-side contrast: api.reka.ai/v1 can be plugged straight into coding agents that support custom endpoints.
